rules.R1: Only 20 canonical amino acids are allowed at each GB1 site.
rules.R2: Prefer one-site changes relative to an already measured parent.
rules.R3: Use conservative versus radical substitutions as contrasting hypotheses.
rules.R4: A beneficial substitution is supported only in its measured sequence background.
rules.R5: Combining beneficial substitutions requires new measurements because of epistasis.
rules.R6: Count mutations relative to WT separately from changes relative to a parent.
rules.R7: Protein-level 4-AA variants cannot contain a stop codon; DNA design needs codon checks.
